caption: Vulnerability is your greatest strength #usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #usa #mentalhealth
transcript: Trying to appear strong makes you weaker. When we hide our pain, we build a wall. Around the sorrow, around ourselves, this wall does not protect your heart, it traps it. Vulnerability is not weakness, it is the courage to open, like light through a window letting the world witness your truth. When you allow yourself to be seen, truly seen, your deepest hurts, your true feelings, that is when healing begins to enter, not when you pretend. To be truly strong, you must first be vulnerable. I wrote more about this in my book, The Way Back to Stillness, link in my bio.
